name: PostgreSQL Sink
shortDescription: Consume data from a Kafka topic in Quix and persist the data to a PostgreSQL database.

Variables.Name: POSTGRES_CONNECTION
Variables.Description: PostgreSQL host, port, database and credentials from a shared Variable Group.
Variables.VariableGroupDescription: Shared PostgreSQL host, port, database and credentials.

Variables.Description: Host address of the PostgreSQL instance
Port of the PostgreSQL instance (80 for the bundled server on the internal Quix network)
Database name to connect to, and to initialise the server with

Variables.Name: POSTGRES_TABLE
Variables.Description: The PostgreSQL table where data will be stored. If the table does not exist, it will be created automatically.

Variables.Name: POSTGRES_SCHEMA
Variables.Description: The schema name. Schemas are a way of organizing tables and not related to the table data, referenced as `<schema_name>.<table_name>`. PostrgeSQL uses `public` by default under the hood.

Variables.Name: POSTGRES_SCHEMA_AUTO_UPDATE
Variables.Description: Automatically update the schema by adding new columns when new fields are detected.

Variables.Name: POSTGRES_PRIMARY_KEY_COLUMNS
Variables.Description: An optional comma-separated list of primary key column(s). Often paired with `POSTGRES_UPSERT_ON_PRIMARY_KEY=true`

Variables.Name: POSTGRES_UPSERT_ON_PRIMARY_KEY
Variables.Description: If true, upsert based on the given primary_keys, else every message is treated as an independent entry.

Variables.Name: CONSUMER_GROUP_NAME
Variables.Description: The name of the consumer group to use when consuming from Kafka

Variables.Name: BATCH_SIZE
Variables.Description: The number of records that the sink holds before flushing data to PostgreSQL.

Variables.Name: BATCH_TIMEOUT
Variables.Description: The number of seconds that the sink holds before flushing data to PostgreSQL.
